messages.text: The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Fixed both issues: equal or worse games preserve the best score, and unfinished sizes show `none`. Added regression coverage for size switching and reloads.

All 140 unit/static tests and 77 browser tests pass on the specified versions. Type checks and builds pass.

Changed files pass formatting. The full formatting check flags pre-existing issues in [replay.test.ts](/work/scripts/replay.test.ts), [accessibility.e2e.test.ts](/work/tests/accessibility.e2e.test.ts), and [layout.e2e.test.ts](/work/tests/layout.e2e.test.ts).
